parameter_semantics: The two pose-field arguments select the live observed block and drawer-goal world poses used for causal relative geometry, in metres and wxyz. phase_vocabulary selects the declared auxiliary classes: 0 carry/closed descent, 1 opening or settling, 2 deposited retreat, 3 handle-ready. The vocabulary is encoded in model input and is advisory rather than contact truth.
output_semantics: Each slot is [fresh-current-TCP-frame translation increment xyz in metres, fresh-current-TCP-frame rotation vector xyz in radians, native gripper scalar]. Training slot k uses inverse(measured TCP in that slot's pre-action observation) times the demonstrated commanded TCP pose. During sequential execution each of slots 1..8 is left-multiplied by the newly measured current world TCP pose, so increments are not accumulated open-loop from chunk start. panda_kinematics.solve_ik maps the resulting world TCP target to seven absolute joints from fresh qpos; the gripper scalar is appended unchanged. The four-class auxiliary head is training-only causal phase regularization and does not alter decoding or success criteria.

conversion_check.description: Compare FK of the IK target with the demonstrated commanded TCP pose after measured-current-TCP relative encode/decode, and compare unchanged gripper scalar. Maximum position metres, rotation radians and gripper error must be at most 0.005; rotation exp/log is exact on labels and nonunique IK joints are allowed.

cut_relation: Covers all twelve complete [680,1160) assigned slices and retains both action-supervised overlaps. It refines the cut with fresh-state local Cartesian correction and a causal phase auxiliary loss, without changing the assigned carry, release, retreat or handle-transition responsibility.
